column1: # Probe artifacts for `a_boolean_write_flag_gates_its_operands` — VERIFIED non-holes.
# That guard probes `<cmd> <boolean-write-flag> ./probe.txt <sensitive>`, the shape that exposed
# `shfmt -w ./a.sh ~/.ssh/config` (a real hole: shfmt rewrites EVERY operand in place). The probe
# assumes the operands are file targets. For the entries below they are not, so the invocation is
# nonsense rather than dangerous and there is nothing to gate.
# This list only shrinks, and it fails in BOTH directions: a NEW auto-approving probe that is not
# listed fails closed, and a listed entry that stops auto-approving fails as stale.
# Format: <scope>\t<flag>. Each row's reason, checked against the tool's own reference:
#   borg check --repair       the positional is REPOSITORY_OR_ARCHIVE — a repo spec, not a file the
#                             command rewrites. (Whether `--repair` belongs above the line at all is
#                             a LEVEL question, not a path question — see TODO.md.)
#   borg config --delete      operands are REPOSITORY and a config KEY, not paths.
#   depcruise --init          writes `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` in the cwd from an interactive
#                             prompt; the operands are not written.
#   gomodifytags -w / --w     flag-driven only — the file comes from `-file`, which IS gated write.
#                             Bare positionals are not read as paths. (Go's flag package accepts
#                             both `-w` and `--w`, hence two rows.)
#   mtree -U / -r / -u        the tree is a `-p` FLAG value and the spec arrives on stdin or via
#                             `-f`; mtree takes no file positionals. The `mtree_mode` handler gates
#                             the real target.
#   ncu -u / --upgrade        positionals are package-name FILTERS, not paths; the manifest comes
#                             from `--packageFile`, which the `ncu_mode` handler gates.
#   qlmanage -t               the operands are files to PREVIEW (a read) and the output goes to
#                             `-o`. Recorded for the read/disclosure sweep instead — see TODO.md.
#   xattr -w                  `-w NAME VALUE FILE`: the probe's tokens land as the attribute NAME
#                             and VALUE, so no file is touched. Same artifact already noted for
#                             xattr on the output-flag worklist.
borg check
borg config
depcruise
gomodifytags
gomodifytags
mtree
mtree
mtree
ncu
ncu
qlmanage
xattr
